summary: Seven new exposed synthetic cases and35 stations executed with six passing mechanistic assertions. Existing bilateral profile fits measure LOCAL widths30/40px and reveal a7.5px displaced centerline. Re-centering the unchanged Dev72 operation recovers score1 after an allzero width bank at the asserted pose. Ragged global width29.238px hides station widths29.026–47.875px; a crossing global width40px/Dev72 mean.8 hides a central station with no pair and score0. A broad bright ellipse has no pair in the source profile window. Most importantly, a non-path organic capsule exactly reproduces the corridor40 global profiles, all five station profiles, fitted edges, width rows and raw channel outputs. Bilateral composition adds geometric diagnostics but does not establish semantic path identity or universally reject organic patches. Perfect corridor40 also ties Dev72 candidates40/42 at score1, so strict Dev72 winner separation cannot be silently required for observed edge width40.
